note: Eval coverage manifest. Every skill under skills/ is listed here as tested or exempt; run-skill-evals --validate and harness_check C13 fail for any skill that is absent. A tested skill has scenarios under skills/<name>/evals/; an exempt skill has none and carries the reason. `required` names scenario files whose every expected behavior must grade mechanically under --run; an ungraded required scenario makes --run exit non-zero. The renderer rejects unknown SKILL.md frontmatter keys, so coverage lives here and never in frontmatter.
